title: Chapter 236 - Driven By Temptation
content:
Chapter 236 - Driven By Temptation

With such a cruel reality in front of him, how could King Han not feel worried.

Therefore, King Han has continuously squeezed South Korea's potential over the years, and worked hard to transfuse blood for the coalition forces on the front line.

It is enough to only hope that the coalition forces can continue, not to win, but to achieve a tie so that South Korea can continue to survive.

But now, seeing that the South Korean army has been killed and wounded, and the coalition forces seem to be defeated, why not worry the King of Han!

He gave everything for the coalition forces, and even his body was slowly overdrawn, all because of sorrow! But seeing that my hard work in the past two years will be in vain, the fear and hatred in my heart should not be said.

Zhong Yu turned around and looked at King Han, whose face was full of anxiety and fear, chuckled a few times, and comforted him:

"King Han, don't worry. This army has not been defeated so quickly. The king has already expected the current situation. Naturally, there are also backup players. Let's see, King Han, how will it develop next!"

Hearing this, Han Wang was overjoyed, could things really turn around? Did the coalition really fail so quickly?

After that, Han Wang looked hopeful, and his eyes were fixed on Zhong Yu's face, only to see his next actions and decisions.

After a little comfort to King Han and King Yan, Zhong Yu didn't look at King Han, but turned to look at the entourage beside him, who was the commander of this army, Cao Cao.

"Meng De, you can act according to plan!" Zhong Yu said.

"Yes, Your Highness, I will give you an order now!" Cao Cao nodded in response, then turned his head, and gave orders to the messengers beside him.

"If the order continues, it means that His Majesty the Emperor of the Great Yuguo has an order. Anyone who can cause enough damage to the Qin army in this battle and make enough military exploits will split the country and divide the country. Those who have made great achievements will be given the title of a county. I hope that all the generals will fight bravely against the Qin State, and make unrivaled achievements, so as to be honored by the state!" Cao Cao's sonorous and powerful voice clearly reached the ears of the surrounding Baimi people. In the middle, everyone changed their colors and showed excitement.

Among them, there are two kings, King Yan and King Han. Even if they are one king, they can't help but be amazed by the great generosity of the royal family.

They don't doubt whether Yuguo will split the land and seal the marquis, they just feel puzzled why Yuguo has put in so much effort for this battle, even willing to cede the territory, but the following generals enjoy the incense of the country.

But no matter what they think, as long as they know that the coalition forces will not be defeated this time, that's all.

Never underestimate people's ambition to climb up. Because of this ambition, under the system of farming and warfare, Qin became a wild beast released from its cage, slowly annexing the whole world.

However, the farming war system of the Qin State is nothing more than dividing some fields and titles, and it is far from being a feudal marquis by cracking the soil. Now it is even worse than the temptation to directly seal the country, this is an opportunity to reach the sky in one step!

Since the fall of Chengzhou, the world has never been divided into feudal vassals. The entire Central Plains, and even the entire world, have not had more than one country for more than a hundred years.

It used to be princes, and they all started to annex. Everyone thinks that their territory is not populated enough, so how can they distribute it to their subordinates, raising tigers for trouble?

Under this mentality, those ministers and heroes also knew that there was no possibility of enfeoffing and establishing a country, so they stopped their ambitions, and turned to become a general and become a prime minister, and began to develop.

But now someone suddenly said to them, you helped me fight the war and made great contributions. I will grant you a country and let you become those high-ranking monarchs. Then your descendants will continue to be monarchs forever.

You said that these soldiers who yearn to change their own destiny and want to be a master, what will they do?

Although for those ordinary soldiers, it is impossible for them to make meritorious deeds to seal the country, the only ones who have the opportunity to seal the country are their generals.

But turn around and think about it, if their general is the king of the country, then these soldiers who followed the general, went through life and death, made great contributions, and won such a chance to seal the country, what kind of reward would they get?

I'm afraid, at least he has a knighthood!

And there are also fiefs of one or two villages. From then on, these soldiers can also sit on the title of nobility, and their posture is also a noble species with noble blood flowing.

With such a temptation, these soldiers will definitely burst out with a strong will to fight, even if they understand that they may die before they succeed, and it is hard-won to get there, and even this one-time opportunity must not be missed by them.

Isn't it just desperate? Who is afraid of whom? Anyway, even if they escaped, they might not live for long. Not to mention the supervising teams, but after leaving the army, it would be a matter of rations that would kill many of them.

The reason why I dare not fight now is that I don't have an obsession in my heart. I don't have the goal and belief of fighting, so I will be defeated.

But now it is different, the opportunity to become a master, the opportunity to change their own destiny, the opportunity to let their descendants be like themselves, the opportunity to become a nobleman, is clearly in front of them, how could they run away again!

If you don't try your best and risk everything to fight for it, that would be a strange thing.

"Brothers, have you all heard it? The order of His Majesty the Emperor of the Great Yu Kingdom, those who have made great achievements will divide the land and establish a country. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. As long as you help the general make contributions, I will never forget you. At that time, I will be the king, and you will be my ministers and nobles, and we will share the wealth together!" A general said excitedly to the soldiers behind him with a happy face.

Similarly, in various places on the battlefield, countless generals said the same thing, the only difference is the way of expression.

They also worked hard, such a land-cracked country, from now on, can enjoy the incense of the descendants of the country, become the founding king of a country, and the opportunity to leave a name in history is in front of them, and they will not be allowed to let it go!

The entire remaining coalition forces originally had only more than 60,000 people, barely half of the Qin army, and their morale was low, and the front line was crumbling.

At this moment, under the encouragement and temptation of this order, he stabilized in an instant, and started a large-scale counterattack. All the generals and soldiers seemed to be crazy, their faces were excited, and they yelled loudly, towards Qin Qin. Army madness shocks the past.

All of a sudden, the Qin army, which was about to take advantage of the victory and pursue it, was suddenly stunned, and many positions were lost at once. It was not until two or three kilometers behind that the camp was stabilized and barely supported.
